data.summary: tests/test_testselect_recall.py merge_log greps '^merge ' so a hand-made 'merge main' commit (git merge main -m 'merge main') in a task branch lands in main and turns the recall test red: it replays that merge's whole diff as one merge's co-changed tests. Repro: in a task worktree git merge main -m 'merge main'; pytest tests/test_testselect_recall.py (fails: precise selection lost tests ... recall 63/79). Fix: restrict to ddflow's own 'merge <item>:' subjects or first-parent merges of main.
data.title: recall test counts a hand-made 'merge main' commit as a ddflow merge

Fixes bug Bd25dfeaa42: ddflow pins regenerate (golden-snapshots recipe: pytest tests/golden --snapshot-update) ends 'REAL repository ... was modified by the suite: added [ M tests/golden/__snapshots__/test_golden_outputs.ambr]' and exits 1, so the recipe fails and its files are put back. tests/_isolation.py _updating() asks config.getoption('snapshot_update', False) but syrupy declares --snapshot-update with dest='update_snapshots' (syrupy/__init__.py:55-58), so a snapshot-update session is never recognised; only DDFLOW_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 works. Repro: change a knob, ddflow pins regenerate --only golden-snapshots. Fix: getoption('update_snapshots', False). Found on fix-Bd92e5da53c.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-Bd25dfeaa42 --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed Bd25dfeaa42 --regression-test <test>` first).
data.title: Fix bug Bd25dfeaa42: pins regenerate golden-snapshots always fails: tests/_isolation.py reads the snapshot_update opt...

data.summary: In an item worktree, git merge main conflicts; after resolving, git commit is refused: 'N staged path(s) are not covered by a lease you hold' naming files the branch's own earlier commits changed (exemptions.py, parsers/__init__.py) because another live lease (DX-decide-claim) now holds them. ddflow update --globs cannot widen (overlap), so the merge cannot be concluded until the other lease ends. Repro: DX-health-watch worktree, git merge main, resolve, git commit. Expected: a merge-concluding commit is exempt from the lease check, or overlapping globs may be shared for already-committed branch work.
data.title: merge-conclusion commit blocked by another lease on files the branch itself changed
